# PI HCM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Full function HCM based in Hong Kong and the Greater China Region, providing localized pay engines, clouds and local deployment. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundaries | Overseas coverage requires country-by-country confirmation; early implementation challenges are disclosed in parent group announcements; AI capabilities should verify actual available language and authority. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Overseas coverage requires country-by-country confirmation; early implementation challenges are disclosed in parent group announcements; and AI capabilities should verify actual available language and authority. |
